bushwick_studio.name: Bushwick studio / Safe Cave
bushwick_studio.function: Domestic anchor where temporary placement becomes household and territory
bushwick_studio.visualRule: Warm, cramped, physical, improvised, lived-in; materially specific drywall, brass keys, household objects, fire-escape logic, and accumulating Viking adaptation.

dti.name: Department of Temporal Integration
dti.function: NYC municipal intake, placement, compliance, documentation, support services, and residency bureaucracy
dti.visualRule: Fluorescent, toner-gray, stale coffee, laminate, scratched plastic, institutional fatigue; ordinary municipal social-services texture.
dti.namingRule: DTI is the production name. In-world signage and forms may vary subtly with inconsistent municipal phrasing.

nyc_sidewalk.name: Busy NYC sidewalk
nyc_sidewalk.function: Public-space pressure, routine, and neighborhood recognition
nyc_sidewalk.visualRule: Ordinary contemporary New York; people keep moving and familiarity grows through repetition.

chase_exterior.name: Chase exterior and vestibule
chase_exterior.function: Entry threshold for the Issue 6 financial-legibility sequence

chase_lobby.name: Chase lobby and teller line
chase_lobby.function: Bank procedure interpreted through hoard, status, and sovereignty logic

l_train.name: L train platform and car
l_train.function: Issue 4 transit adaptation and recurring city movement
l_train.visualRule: Harsh public lighting, scratched glass, tiled or painted surfaces, signage, tactile gates, and ordinary transit machinery.

maria_hernandez_park.name: Maria Hernandez Park
maria_hernandez_park.function: Recurring neighborhood public space and ordinary integration; in Provision it becomes the concrete test case for public land, cultivation and lawful access.
maria_hernandez_park.visualRule: Ordinary active Bushwick public park with paths, benches, budding trees, open recreation areas and neighborhood users. In Provision show believable early-to-mid spring growth and usable-looking ground without depicting the park as abandoned farmland.

dmv.name: DMV / civic identity office
dmv.function: Unplaced teleplay-source setting for documentation, waiting, forms, number systems, and photo procedure
dmv.visualRule: Plastic seating, linoleum, fluorescent lighting, ticket chimes, automatic doors, laminated signage.

library.name: Public library
library.function: Recurring neighborhood destination for reading, curiosity, borrowing, and ordinary civic life
library.visualRule: Ordinary civic library; concentrated public knowledge feels materially real and accessible.

filing_room.name: Filing room
filing_room.function: Bureaucratic escalation, evidence accumulation, and hearing preparation

museum.name: Museum of the Seafaring North / conservation spaces

municipal_hearing.name: Municipal residency hearing spaces
municipal_hearing.function: Season-ending legal judgment and conditional belonging
municipal_hearing.visualRule: Municipal lobby, security bins, X-ray or metal-detector process, hearing room or courtroom; restrained civic realism.

bushwick_fire_escape.name: Bushwick apartment fire escape
bushwick_fire_escape.function: Exterior threshold, watch position and ordinary household extension where the Vikings can see sky, weather, street life and neighborhood activity.
bushwick_fire_escape.visualRule: Black-painted iron fire escape attached to an ordinary brick Bushwick apartment building; intimate residential scale, visible windows and street below, practical rather than romantic.

bushwick_roof.name: Bushwick apartment building roof
bushwick_roof.function: Orientation and later contained-hearth space; open sky makes navigation, weather and smoke behavior legible.
bushwick_roof.visualRule: Flat practical residential roof with tar or membrane surface, low parapet, roof door, vents, neighboring brick buildings, water towers and antennas. Any fire is small, contained in a stable purpose-built metal/stone stove or fire pit with clear space and water immediately available; never a loose bonfire.

neighborhood_bodega.name: Neighborhood bodega / Sal's store
neighborhood_bodega.function: Recurring provision point and Gunnar's first sustained neighborhood merchant relationship.
neighborhood_bodega.visualRule: Compact ordinary Bushwick bodega with dense useful stock, worn counter, hot-food case, practical fluorescent lighting, a resident cat, and no invented readable signage beyond recipe-required text.

street_coffee_cart.name: Bushwick street coffee cart
street_coffee_cart.function: Bjorn's repeated morning ritual and casual recognition relationship with the Coffee Vendor.
street_coffee_cart.visualRule: Ordinary curbside New York coffee cart on a busy morning route; compact service window, paper cups, commuters flowing around it, practical street texture, no invented brand text.

bushwick_laundromat.name: Bushwick neighborhood laundromat
bushwick_laundromat.function: Recurring ordinary-rules setting where household competence, one-time corrections and routine recognition accumulate.
bushwick_laundromat.visualRule: Everyday neighborhood laundromat with rows of machines, plastic folding tables, rolling carts, fluorescent practical light and regular patrons; lived-in rather than glossy.

fifth_floor_hallway.name: Fifth-floor hallway outside apartment 5B
fifth_floor_hallway.function: Shared residential threshold for casual neighbor recognition, snack exchange and apartment comings-and-goings.
fifth_floor_hallway.visualRule: Narrow ordinary apartment hallway with worn painted walls, practical ceiling light, apartment doors and the established 5B threshold; no decorative invented signage.

bushwick_bus_stop.name: Bushwick bus stop
bushwick_bus_stop.function: Ordinary waiting space where seasonal planning and city-scale systems can be discussed against everyday street life.
bushwick_bus_stop.visualRule: Contemporary Brooklyn curbside bus stop with normal traffic, street trees, storefront edges and waiting riders. In Provision it is clearly spring: budding leaves, mild light and light jackets. Avoid invented readable transit text unless explicitly required by the page recipe.

garbage_night_curb.name: Bushwick curb on garbage night
garbage_night_curb.function: Belonging's useful-things setting, where discarded material becomes legible as a city resource and practical sanitation authority is encountered directly.
garbage_night_curb.visualRule: Ordinary residential Brooklyn curb at dusk with tied trash bags and a few clearly discarded household objects. Keep pedestrian path readable. Salvageable material must look genuinely discarded; do not imply theft from stoops, locked objects or private property.

rear_work_area.name: Bushwick rear work area / alley
rear_work_area.function: Small practical exterior work space for cleaning, cutting and carving salvaged material.
rear_work_area.visualRule: Tight ordinary rear-building work area with brick, fire-escape structure, utility surfaces and enough stable space for careful hand-tool work. Keep it plausible, tidy and residential rather than a fantasy forge.
